items.title: 7.2.2 Measuring the rate of a chemical reaction (reaction ki rate napna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.2.2, printed pages 147-148.

blocks.text: Reaction ki rate napne ke liye reaction ke dauran regular intervals (barabar waqfon) par reactants ya products ki concentration maloom ki jati hai.

blocks.caption: Table 7.1 Time ke saath HI ki concentration, 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g)

blocks.text: Kisi waqt ki rate maloom karne ke liye x-axis par waqt aur y-axis par reactant ki concentration le kar graph banaya jata hai, jis se ek curve milta hai. Misal: 500°C par HI ka H₂ aur I₂ mein decomposition (toot jana). Table 7.1 ke data se graph banta hai (Figure 7.2). HI reactant hai, is liye curve neeche girta hai. Curve jitna steep (zyada dhalaan wala) ho, reaction utni tez; shuru mein slope sab se zyada hai, is liye rate bhi shuru mein sab se zyada hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan graph ko 'Fig (7.3)' kehti hai; asal mein yeh Figure 7.2 hai (Figure 7.3 colorimetry wali tasveer hai).

Maslan 100 seconds par rate napne ke liye curve par us point par tangent (sirf ek point ko chhoone wali seedhi line) kheenchein aur us ka slope napein. Tangent ka slope us instant (lamhe) ki rate hai. Tangent ko hypotenuse (tirchi side) bana kar right-angled triangle ABC complete karein. Figure 7.2 mein tangent 0.04 mol dm⁻³ neeche aata hai, aur yeh kami taqreeban 160 s mein hoti hai.

blocks.text_alt: rate = 0.04 mol dm⁻³ / 160 s ≈ 2.5×10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹

blocks.text: Is ka matlab hai ke 100 s ke qareeb HI ki concentration har second taqreeban 2.5 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ kam ho rahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne 100 s par rate = 0.04 / 100 = 4 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ likha hai. Lekin Figure 7.2 mein tangent ka 0.04 mol dm⁻³ girna taqreeban 160 s mein hota hai, 100 s mein nahi; is liye rate = 0.04 / 160 = taqreeban 2.5 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ hai. Table 7.1 bhi yehi deti hai: 50 s se 150 s tak (0.0716 − 0.0457) / 100 = 2.6 × 10⁻⁴. Kitab ki agli line '2.5 moles per dm⁻³' kehti hai; sahi 2.5 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ har second hai.

blocks.alt: [HI] (0 se 0.10 mol dm-3) ka Time (s) (0 se 350) ke muqable grid graph. Hara girta curve 0.10 se shuru ho kar 50 se 350 s tak peele points se guzarta hai. Neela tangent curve ko 100 s par chhoota hai aur y-axis par 0.08 se 0.04 ke neeche tak jata hai. Right-angled triangle ABC: A (0.08) se C (0.04) tak y-axis par vertical (khari) line, label 0.04 mol dm-3, aur C se tangent par B (taqreeban 164 s) tak horizontal (leti hui) line.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.2: 508 degrees C par reaction 2HI(g) se H2(g) + I2(g) mein waqt ke saath HI ki concentration ki tabdeeli (kitab ki Figure 7.2 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke graph par y-axis ka label '[H1]' (digit ek) chhapa hai aur axes ke letters ulte hain (X oopar, Y daen); yahan [HI] aur aam tareeqe ke mutabiq Y oopar, X daen likha gaya hai. Triangle ki horizontal (leti hui) side CB tangent tak taqreeban 164 s lambi hai, is liye 100 s par rate = 0.04 / 164 = taqreeban 2.5 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ hai.
Agar x-axis par waqt aur y-axis par kisi product (H₂ ya I₂) ki concentration lein to upar charhta (rising) curve milta hai. 100 s par us ka tangent bhi rate deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke product ka tangent bhi wahi 4 × 10⁻⁴ deta hai. Lekin 2HI → H₂ + I₂ mein 2 mole HI se 1 mole H₂ banta hai, is liye H₂ ya I₂ wala tangent HI wale ka aadha hai: taqreeban 1.3 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt: a) Table 7.1 ka HI data plot karein. b) 300 s par (concentration 0.03 mol dm⁻³) tangent se rate nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Waqt (x-axis) aur [HI] (y-axis) ka girta hua curve banta hai. 300 s par (0.0296 mol dm⁻³) tangent khenchein: 200 s se 400 s tak (Δt = 200 s) tangent par concentration 0.014 mol dm⁻³ girti hai, to rate = 0.014 / 200 = 7.0 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (taqreeban 7 × 10⁻⁵). 250 s se 300 s ki average (0.0040 / 50 = 8 × 10⁻⁵) thori zyada aati hai, kyunke woh tangent nahin balke do points ko jorne wali seedhi line hai.

answer_figure.alt: Table 7.1 ka graph: x-axis waqt 0-400 s, y-axis [HI] 0-0.10 mol dm⁻³. Saat narangi points (0 s par 0.100 se 300 s par 0.0296 tak) hare girte curve par hain. 300 s wale point par neela tangent; us par triangle: Δc = 0.014 mol dm⁻³ (200 s se 400 s tak), Δt = 200 s. Dabbe mein rate = 0.014 / 200 = 7.0 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: table 7.1 ke HI data ka graph aur 300 s par tangent se rate
answer_figure.long_description: Table 7.1 ke saat points (0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250 aur 300 s) plot kar ke hamwar (smooth) girta hua curve banaya gaya hai. 300 s par (concentration 0.0296, yani taqreeban 0.03 mol dm⁻³) curve ko sirf ek point par chhoone wala tangent khencha gaya hai. Tangent ko hypotenuse bana kar triangle: 200 s se 400 s tak (Δt = 200 s) concentration 0.014 mol dm⁻³ girti hai. Rate = slope = 0.014 / 200 = 7.0 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt: c) [HI] = 0.10, 0.050 aur 0.02 mol dm⁻³ par isi tareeqe se rate nikalein. d) Waqt ke saath rate ke bare mein kya nateeja nikalta hai? e) Kis concentration par rate sab se zyada aur kis par sab se kam hai?
blocks.explanation: Har concentration par curve ka tangent khench kar us ka slope nikalein. 0.10 mol dm⁻³ (t = 0) par tangent sab se steep hai: 50 s mein tangent par 0.040 mol dm⁻³ kami, rate = 0.040 / 50 = 8.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (taqreeban 8 × 10⁻⁴). 0.050 mol dm⁻³ (taqreeban 125 s) par tangent: 200 s mein 0.040 kami, rate = 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹. 0.02 mol dm⁻³ Table 7.1 (300 s tak) se aage hai; curve ko aage barha kar (taqreeban 500 s) tangent se rate taqreeban 3 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ aati hai. Result (nateeja): waqt ke saath concentration kam hoti hai aur rate bhi kam hoti jati hai; rate 0.10 mol dm⁻³ par sab se zyada aur 0.02 mol dm⁻³ par sab se kam hai.

answer_figure.alt: [HI] vs time (0-550 s) ka graph: Table 7.1 ke points hare curve par, 300 s ke baad curve dashed (aage barhaya gaya). Teen tangent: surkh 0.10 par (t = 0), triangle Δt = 50 s, Δc = 0.040; neela 0.050 par (taqreeban 125 s), triangle Δt = 200 s, Δc = 0.040; gehra neela 0.02 par (taqreeban 500 s). Dabbe mein rates: 8.0 × 10⁻⁴, 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ aur taqreeban 3 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: [HI] = 0.10, 0.050 aur 0.02 mol dm⁻³ par tangent se rate
answer_figure.long_description: Table 7.1 ka curve 300 s ke baad dashed line se aage barhaya gaya hai taa ke 0.02 mol dm⁻³ tak pohanch sake. Shuru (0.10) par surkh tangent sab se steep hai: triangle mein 50 s mein 0.040 mol dm⁻³ kami, rate 8.0 × 10⁻⁴. 0.050 par neela tangent kam steep hai: 200 s mein 0.040 kami, rate 2.0 × 10⁻⁴. 0.02 par gehra neela tangent taqreeban chapta hai, rate taqreeban 3 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹. Concentration jitni kam, tangent utna chapta aur rate utni kam.

items: Concentration ko waqt ke muqable plot karein; kisi waqt par tangent ka slope us waqt ki rate hai.
HI 100 s par: 0.04 mol dm⁻³ / taqreeban 160 s = 2.5 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹; H₂ ya I₂ ki rate is ki aadhi.
